title: The Aztec City Built on a Lake
description: Tenochtitlan in 1519: canals, causeways, floating gardens and a great pyramid.

scenes.narration: When Spanish soldiers first saw this city, some said it was like something from a dream.
scenes.image_prompt: Spanish conquistadors on a causeway gazing at a vast Aztec city rising from a lake, 1519

scenes.narration: It's 1519. This is Tenochtitlan, capital of the Aztecs, built on an island in Lake Texcoco.
scenes.image_prompt: aerial view of Tenochtitlan on its island in a blue lake, white temples and canals, volcanoes behind

scenes.narration: Huge causeways link the city to the shore. Canals run through it like streets.
scenes.image_prompt: Aztec canoes gliding along a canal lined with white houses and flowers in Tenochtitlan

scenes.narration: Around two hundred thousand people may live here, more than almost any city in Spain.
scenes.image_prompt: huge busy Aztec market of Tlatelolco with traders, feathers, cacao, pottery and crowds

scenes.narration: Farm plots built out into the lake, called chinampas, feed the city.
scenes.image_prompt: Aztec farmers tending green chinampa garden plots surrounded by water canals

scenes.narration: At the centre stands the Templo Mayor, a great pyramid with twin temples on top.
scenes.image_prompt: the Templo Mayor pyramid of Tenochtitlan with twin shrines on top, smoke rising, crowds below

scenes.narration: Within two years, war and smallpox would bring the city down.
scenes.image_prompt: Tenochtitlan under siege, smoke over the lake, Spanish brigantines on the water

scenes.narration: Today, Mexico City stands right on top of it. Which lost city should we rebuild next?
scenes.image_prompt: modern Mexico City with the excavated Templo Mayor ruins in the foreground, sunset
